extracts.lead_summary: Fourth up week, and the same split, wider. XLU closed $42.56 (+0.8%); Thursday's $42.87 was its best close since September 8. The 10-year closed under 5% for the first time since September 22 — 4.95% Thursday, 4.99% Friday — and October hike odds fell from about 28% to about 7%. The wires took it: ConEd to a 52-week closing high, Duke and NextEra +2.9%. The pair took the other side of the same trade. Meta raised its capex guidance Wednesday night, AI-infrastructure names sold Thursday, and Vistra fell 9.8% in a day, Constellation 5.7%. Constellation closed $253.45, its lowest close since July 20 and $14 under the gap its Google contract opened. NextEra beat. PG&E missed its consensus by a cent and fell 3.5% on the week. The fund is half bond, half AI, and this week the bond half paid for both.
